'''Control maintenance droids''' were large<ref name="Freedom" /> [[Class two droid/Legends|second-degree]]<ref name="degree" /> [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that had several tentacles. One was assigned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial mining complex|mobile mining operation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alabash]] under the command of [[Control (droid)|Control]], a [[Terreene Brainiac]] class of [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]].<ref name="Freedom" />
